title: The Battle of the Somme begins
summary: British and French troops attacked German lines along the Somme; the British army suffered about 57,000 casualties on the first day alone.
reason: The Allies planned a joint offensive to break through, which also became a way to relieve pressure on the French at Verdun.
significance: It became one of the bloodiest battles in history and a symbol of the slaughter of World War I.
